ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from entering a value in the Anticipated Registered Donors (ARD) field on Opportunity records where the associated Drive Site (Drive_Site__c) is of Record Type = Fixed Site and Operation Type = Integrated or Non Integrated APH.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Anticipated_Registered_Donors__c)), TEXT(Type_of_Drive__c) = "Fixed Site", OR( Drive_Site_Operation_Type__c = "Integrated", Drive_Site_Operation_Type__c = "Non Integrated APH" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: ARD values are not permitted for IFS & Non-Int APH.
